title: Rebar Cutters & Rebar Cutting Machines in Canada | NovoTech
meta_description: GMS hydraulic, mechanical and heavy-duty rebar cutters in Canada, from the portable POWER 24 to the SH 60 for Ø2-3/8″ (60 mm) bar. Specs in inches, CSA panels, parts in Mississauga.
intro: Hydraulic and mechanical rebar cutters built by GMS in Turkey and supplied in Canada by NovoTech: the H series hydraulic cutters on cast-iron wheels for sites and shops, the fast M series mechanical cutters, the double-acting SH 45 and SH 60 for heavy bar, and the portable POWER 24 on single-phase power. Every model cuts two smaller bars at once.

faq.q: Hydraulic or mechanical rebar cutter — which one should I buy?
faq.a: A hydraulic H series cutter is quiet, needs less maintenance and can stop mid-stroke, which suits construction sites and general shops. A mechanical M series cutter cuts faster (0.8 s per cut) and suits a rebar shop cutting all day. For bar above Ø2″ (50 mm) or continuous heavy work choose the double-acting SH 45 or SH 60.

faq.q: Can I run a rebar cutter on single-phase power?
faq.a: The portable POWER 24 has a built-in transformer and runs on 110 V or 220 V single-phase. The H, M and SH cutters are three-phase and are supplied for 600 V; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V are available on request.

faq.q: What does the 45 / 65 / 85 kg/mm² cutting capacity mean?
faq.a: The three columns are the manufacturer's ratings for rebar of different tensile strengths: 45 kg/mm² (≈ 64,000 psi), 65 kg/mm² (≈ 92,500 psi) and 85 kg/mm² (≈ 120,900 psi). Canadian Grade 400W rebar has a minimum tensile strength of 540 MPa (≈ 55 kg/mm²), so the 65 kg/mm² column is a safe guide for everyday Canadian bar.

faq.q: Are replacement cutting blades available in Canada?
faq.a: Yes. NovoTech stocks cutting blades, hydraulic parts and electrical components for GMS cutters in Mississauga, Ontario. Blades are reversible and can be turned to a fresh edge before replacement.

faq.q: Is there a machine that both cuts and bends?
faq.a: Yes — the MAX 40 combined machine cuts up to Ø1-1/8″ (30 mm) and bends up to Ø1-3/8″ (36 mm). You will find it on the rebar bending machines page.
